ValidationRule.description: Terminal ID of Atos Worldline needs to start with 01 or 5
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && (ER_Business_Unit__c ='BENELUX') && ISPICKVAL( ER_Acceptor_Scheme__c ,'C-TAP') && (ISPICKVAL(ER_Acceptor_Provider__c,'Atos-Worldline') || ISPICKVAL(ER_Acceptor_Provider__c,'Atos-Worldline - No invoice')) && NOT(BEGINS( ER_TID_Authorization__c,"01") ||BEGINS(ER_TID_Authorization__c,"5") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Terminal ID of Atos Worldline needs to start with 01 or 5
